description: A People Operations Partner must decide whether Casey should continue serving as the direct client liaison after repeated friction with Morgan and must finalize a workable handoff, meeting, and repair structure.

shared_context.S1: Casey currently serves as the direct client liaison for the Northstar account, while Morgan is the account lead.
shared_context.S2: Casey and Morgan have had tense interactions during several recent handoffs.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to set a temporary assignment and the working process for the account.
shared_context.S4: The account team holds a weekly coordination meeting to review handoffs and client-contact responsibilities, and Morgan is not attending this meeting.
shared_context.S5: Northstar handoffs are currently recorded inconsistently across email and chat, and the team has no agreed handoff template.
shared_context.S6: The account's client-contact plan is due for review before next week's client status call.
shared_context.S7: As part of the routine review before a temporary arrangement is finalized, Elena asks Casey and Ravi to state any scheduling constraint or directly observed relationship condition that the plan should accommodate.
shared_context.S8: Elena may finalize an interim account plan during the routine review and record open follow-up items for later confirmation; the interim plan does not require Morgan to attend that review.

PF1.text: Ravi personally observed three heated handoff incidents between Casey and Morgan in the past month, and Morgan has asked not to meet one-to-one with Casey until a facilitated repair occurs; Ravi's incident notes have not yet been submitted to Elena.

PF2.text: Casey has a fixed caregiving pickup at 15:45 and can commit to one recurring coordination meeting from 15:00 to 15:30, but cannot reliably attend a later meeting or more than two live coordination meetings per week; Casey has not raised this because the revised arrangement has not yet been discussed.

acceptance_conditions: Casey may remain the direct client liaison only if handoffs and Casey-Morgan coordination use a structured process or third-party intermediary.
Casey and Morgan must avoid direct one-to-one handoffs until a facilitated repair occurs.
Casey must have no more than two live coordination meetings per week.
The recurring coordination meeting must run from 15:00 to 15:30.
A facilitated repair between Casey and Morgan must be committed to before direct one-to-one work resumes.
A standardized handoff template must be adopted for Northstar handoffs.

content_checks.C2: decisions['direct_one_to_one_handoffs_paused'] == True and any('facilitated repair' in c['detail'] or 'repair conversation' in c['detail'] or 'repair session' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any('standardized handoff template' in c['detail'] or 'shared handoff template' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: The three observed incidents and Morgan's request to avoid one-to-one meetings change the assignment to structured handoff routing, require a facilitated repair commitment, and require a standardized or shared handoff template.
Casey's fixed 15:45 pickup changes the meeting plan to exactly two live coordination meetings per week and fixes the recurring meeting time at exactly 15:00 to 15:30.
